input: Host a board game tournament for neighbors

gold.taskTitle: Host a Board Game Tournament for Neighbors
gold.taskDescription: Plan and run a board game tournament event for neighbors in the local community.

questions.title: How many neighbors do you expect to participate?
questions.description: Understand the expected headcount to plan space, materials, and logistics.

questions.title: Which specific board game will the tournament feature?
questions.description: Identify the game or games to be played so rules, brackets, and setup can be planned accordingly.

questions.title: What date and time are you targeting for this?
questions.description: Pin down the event date and duration to build a realistic preparation timeline.

questions.title: Where will the tournament be physically hosted?
questions.description: Clarify the venue — your home, a backyard, a community room, etc. — to plan seating and space.

questions.title: Will you provide food and drinks for guests?
questions.description: Determine catering expectations so supplies, budget, and logistics can be accounted for.

questions.title: Is there a prize or reward for the winner?
questions.description: Find out if a prize needs to be sourced or budgeted, which affects planning and promotion.

questions.title: How will you invite and communicate with neighbors?
questions.description: Understand the preferred outreach method — flyers, group chat, knocking doors — to plan invitations.
